scope: Host, Harness, Runtime, and Computer source observations supporting the architecture study

observations.claim: Host owns exact Task revision, lease fencing, one-transition admission, projection checks, and terminal Task invariants.
Host has start, observe, cancel, recover, and completion-collection semantics for an opaque foreign Run and does not let foreign completion directly complete a Task.
Host still contains Provider and cognition execution paths despite the extracted Harness owning Provider adapters and Agent Runs.
Goal coordination snapshots Task revisions and verification application but explicitly does not claim a general scheduler or DAG.
Harness has a caller-neutral immutable Run Contract and independent standalone execution path.
The principal durable cognitive state is messages, observations, budgets, call identities, model identities, and usage.
The first-party Engine is a thin sequential Agent Loop.
The current manifest excludes persistent Session, Session resume/fork, compaction, and local subagents.
Harness already preserves Provider-call and Tool-step identity, uncertainty, receipts, snapshots, traces, recovery, cancellation, and completion proposals.
The Host adapter exposes a foreign-Run lifecycle but start currently drives the complete Run synchronously.
Runtime owns idempotent request admission, Job, Attempt, reservation, process identity, bounded result, Artifact, cancellation, and reconciliation.
The main execution abstraction is one terminal ExecutionPlan, optionally containing a bounded ordered list of steps.
Workspace source state, active-Job exclusion, close fencing, and diff/Artifact evidence provide a strong physical branch substrate.
Runtime deliberately excludes Task meaning, cognition, semantic completion, and hidden queue/scheduler ownership.
Computer already distinguishes graph and loop families and warns against erasing their invariants.
Persistent Sessions, compaction, parallelism, and subagents were deferred pending observed v0 failures and ablations rather than rejected permanently.
Every shared object must own a non-bypassable responsibility and pass net-acceleration, narrower-alternative, and deletion tests; no mandatory graph store is admitted.

conclusion: The source supports reopening a narrow Temporal Cognitive Graph experiment while retaining Host, Harness, Runtime, verifier, and anti-formalism boundaries. It does not prove implementation benefit.
